body.subject: Issue #572: native turn reports wake orchestrators, declared completion stops the seat, and runtime effect and stall stops are removed

items.change: Continue successor runs automatically; deliver native turn reports through parent guidance; route unavailable-parent reports to root; recognize self-declared completion through participant_left reason completed and verify/capture/stop at the turn boundary. Remove required_effect_absent, claim-time missing-diff preflight, stall-cycle reaping, and configured loop/stall interruptions. Notify starts waiting seats. Default review and organize permissions permit delegated review and landing.
items.test: Targeted node --test runs; issue572-continuation 12/12; native flow plus issue443 reroute 15/15; runtime API 4/4; runtime effects 7/7; native access and event/observation ports 13/13; phase73 required-effects 6/6; GV4 watchdog 5/5; surface and seam checks
items.evidence: Real application/MockAdapter tests prove ordinary notification starts one next turn and consumes the pause, explicit done produces a report and completes/stops the worker, and invalid report identities refuse before writing. Missing-effect and automatic stall-stop pins are deleted. Four gate test files: 76 total, 47 pass, 29 existing expected reds, zero unexpected. Worker-verdict C2 fixed and re-run green; its other 13 failures match existing manifest rows.

environmentRed: The tight-cell and worker-verdict files retain their unrelated manifest-declared expected reds; the changed assertions pass. Full deployment verification was not run, under the operator instruction to run targeted files only.

carriedForward: Supersedes contribution-58d35675ef1c414203c4291cc229eac7; includes its independently accepted successor, guidance and permission changes.
Default organize is intentionally the existing broad permission: it includes roster and policy changes and closure as well as landing; recruitment can explicitly restrict grants.

The supplied latest ruling supersedes root automatic nudges. Only the awakened orchestrator decides continuation; self-declared completion and orchestrator stop remain separate from ordinary turn completion.

Root report API returns {event, delivery}; durable row includes workerId, turnSeq, turnEpoch, report (WorkerResult object), assignmentDone and parentId. Root fallback also carries originalReportSeq and deliveryFailure.

Inherited limits contribution-90a93fc7 integration is still running against the old served resident. #561 remains accepted. Rebased #571 contribution-db2f0cd4 is accepted. #568 contribution-cd3e2831 is accepted as partial; external seat worktree registration/reclamation is being added.
needsFromOthers: wake-lead6: root-wake composition is required. 243e5a13 needs a distinct owed-event key (its key currently collides with the report key), object report content, and a test through the real reportTurnEnd callback. This commit invokes _reconcileTurnReportedRows immediately at both root-addressed boundaries when installed.
rigidity-reviewer7: review the native turn, completion, fallback, effect and stall removal slice.
rigidity-571-fixtures: audit and implement remaining wave-driver counter/digest/timer continuation decisions; no additional seats recruited.
root: current resident still serves 65c913f0 behind master e501507a. The limits integration gate has been running for over 30 minutes; no further landing gate was started.
